issues.title: Icon and label collision
issues.description: Leading icon collides directly with item label without spacing.
issues.evidence: The playlist icon touches the 'A' in 'Add to playlist' inside the context menu.
issues.suggestion: Apply standard horizontal margin between leading icons and item text.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed by DOM measurement: ContextMenuSubTrigger lacked gap-2 (icon ended x=767, text started x=767, zero gap); added gap-2.

issues.title: Ragged text alignment across items
issues.description: Items lacking icons omit inset spacing, creating misaligned right-edge text baselines.
issues.evidence: Labels for 'التوسيع التلقائي' and 'التنبيهات النشطة' align further right than text in neighboring items with icons.
issues.suggestion: Apply uniform leading indentation or reserve an icon slot for all items.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed in RTL: CheckboxItem used physical pr-2/pl-8 + absolute left-2, so checkbox text sat 24px closer to the start edge than icon-item text; switched to logical pe-2/ps-8/start-2.

issues.title: Inconsistent item indentation
issues.description: Item text alignment is ragged across items with and without leading icons.
issues.evidence: 'Downloaded' text is shifted left compared to text labels in 'Play next' and 'Add to queue'.
issues.suggestion: Reserve leading icon slot spacing across all menu item rows for uniform alignment.
issues.triageNote: Ragged row was actually the SubTrigger (text at x=767 vs 775 for all other rows — same missing gap-2 root cause as the major issue; 'Downloaded' measured aligned at 775). Fixed by the same gap-2 addition.
